props.title: Omni Interlocken Hotel
props.lede: Omni Interlocken sits on a 27-hole golf course between Denver and Boulder, with views of the Rockies and about 40,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor event space.

headingText.html: It’s a favorite for company meetings from both cities, and for weddings with the ceremony on the lawn and the reception in the ballroom.

rows.text: The Interlocken Ballroom is about 9,100 sq ft with 16-foot ceilings, for receptions of up to about 950 and weddings of up to 500 seated with a dance floor. It divides into four salons, and its pre-function space looks out over the golf course.
The Centennial Ballroom is about 4,100 sq ft, for receptions of up to about 420 and weddings of up to 170 with a dance floor. It splits into two equal halves.
Ponderosa is about 1,600 sq ft, with French doors to the lobby atrium, for dinners of up to 70 with a dance floor.

The Outdoor Pavilion is covered, about 4,750 sq ft, for banquets of up to 320 and receptions of up to 475, with golf course views, a waterfall and a fire pit. It’s open from late May to early October.
The lawn holds ceremonies of up to 220 guests seated, looking out over the golf course.

props.title: Live music for a ceremony on the lawn or a reception in the Pavilion
props.lede: They’re the spaces for the ceremony and the cocktail hour, with the course and the mountains around you.

props.title: Live music in the Interlocken and Centennial ballrooms
props.lede: They’re the spaces for wedding receptions, company dinners and holiday parties.

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. Pinnacle Live is the hotel’s recommended AV company for anything more.
The hotel doesn’t provide a day-of wedding coordinator, so we plan load-in and setup with your planner and the hotel’s events team.
The hotel caters every event in-house.
The Outdoor Pavilion is open from late May to early October, so a winter event moves inside to the ballrooms.
Self-parking at the hotel is free.

props.title: Ask about your date at Omni Interlocken.
props.lede: Send us your date, and we can put together live music for your event at the hotel, from strings on the lawn to a full band in the Interlocken Ballroom.
